messages:
zoe_cs: Heads-up: AtlasWorks renewal in 20 days. Procurement pushed back on the +7% list. They want either (A) a 6-month bridge at current seat pricing, or (B) accept a partial PO now (for 70% of seats) and the remainder via amendment when their finance cycle clears. They also asked if we can include 4 hours of enablement credit as a closing gesture.
dan_ae: Thanks. Two odd asks: a 6mo bridge (not our usual 9mo) and partial PO. Can RevOps approve conditional partial-PO acceptance?
revops-bot: RevOps guidance: partial PO acceptance allowed only if (1) AE obtains exec confirmation email committing to final headcount and payment schedule, and (2) PO clearly lists vendor code and billing entity. Partial PO must state "70% initial quantity; remainder to be billed via amendment". CC fallback allowed for one cycle if PO creation stalls. Revenue recognized on delivered seats per standard policy.
frank_billing: For AP we need exact PO line items and preferred billing entity. Example acceptable PO snippet:
```
PO: ATW-2026-1101
Vendor code: 99234-RW
Line 1: 70 seats - Redwood Inference - monthly
Line 2: Remaining seats: to be invoiced per amendment
Billing entity: Redwood Inc.
```
Also confirm if enablement hours are to be credited on invoice or delivered as service add-on.
maya_legal: If we do a 6-month bridge we should draft a short amendment that: (a) fixes pricing for 6 months, (b) allows partial PO acceptance language, and (c) includes a clause about enablement credit (either invoice credit or SOW addendum). I'll draft language that lets us convert the partial PO into a full contract upon receipt of final PO/amendment. Any SSO/KMS asks?
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope prepared: env-ATW-1101 (status: draft). Link: https://docusign.example/env/ATW-1101
zoe_cs: AtlasWorks mentioned they might request a SAML SSO integration in next quarter, but not for renewal. No KMS. They asked that the enablement hours be scheduled within 60 days of signing.
dan_ae: I'll push procurement for the partial PO today. If AP delays vendor-code creation (>10 days) can we accept a CC for the initial invoice?
revops-bot: CC fallback approved for one invoice cycle while PO is in progress; AE must attach exec confirmation and milestone timeline. Note: partial PO acceptance reduces initial ARR recognized until full conversion.
frank_billing: Also request their EU VAT ID if they plan to consolidate billing under EU entity. Otherwise default to Redwood Inc. for US billing.
maya_legal: Drafting amendment now. I'll include a single-sentence fallback: "If final PO or signed amendment is not received within 60 days, Company reserves the right to invoice remaining seats at published list rates retroactive to amendment effective date."
esign-bot: DocuSign draft uploaded: https://docusign.example/env/ATW-1101 (edit access for maya_legal)
zoe_cs: Thanks — I'll post exec-email once I have it and paste the PO snippet here. Also capturing amenable feedback from Atlas: they said enablement credits and a short onboarding checklist helped them a lot — good datapoint for renewal playbook. Will update thread when PO/exec email land. :v:
